user.title: ClearOne CONVERGE Pro
user.description: Address and Console login of the ClearOne. The connection is checked before saving.

reconfigure.title: Change ClearOne connection
reconfigure.description: Use this when the ClearOne's IP address or login changed. Leave the password empty to keep the current one. The connection is checked before saving; volume caps, scenes and options are kept.

init.title: Options
init.description: Arylic media player: each room speaker streams through it. Power switch: the relay that switches the ClearOne and the amplifier; it gets an on/off button in the Multiroom panel.
